title: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') in GitLab (CVE-2026-11768)
description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 12.4 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user to read private CI/CD job artifacts belonging to other projects through GitLab Pages due to improper validation of file paths.
